when no transfer job is current, takes the next one from the pending queue xfer_pending (interrupts masked), notes the start in the trace (xfer_trace_push 0) and sends it with xfer_job_start; called by the interrupt routine pvr_irq_service, xfer_dma_enqueue, bank_close_and_submit and elan_status_service; part of KamuiTL; observed live 2026-11-10: in the harness scenario attract_demos at vertical blank 6253, called by bank_close_and_submit with no job current, it popped the node 0x0c6040cc from xfer_pending (count 6 to 5) into xfer_current, pushed the trace event (xfer_trace_push) and ran xfer_job_start; at vertical blank 6254, called by pvr_irq_service, jobq_pop gave nothing and xfer_current stayed 0; all four callers of the description called it, and none of the 6,668,693 calls found a job current
